newsitem.title: FINLAND: ICE HOCKEY-PROCHAZKA SCORES TWICE AS CZECHS BEAT FINLAND.
newsitem.headline: ICE HOCKEY-PROCHAZKA SCORES TWICE AS CZECHS BEAT FINLAND.

text.p: Martin Prochazka scored both goals as titleholders, the Czech Republic, beat hosts Finland 2-1 in the world ice hockey championships on Sunday to take the lead in group A.
Copying their performance against Germany on Saturday, the Czechs came from behind to snatch their second one-goal victory.
Mika Nieminen opened the scoring for the Finns but Prochazka equalised with a thundering slapshot with less than a minute to play of the first period.
Prochazka scored the winner in the 42nd minute, hitting a backhand shot into an empty goal with Finnish keeper Jarmo Myllys stranded after failing to intercept a bouncing puck.
